title: Mordheim KB registry — registry/source-documents.yaml
description: The source documents the catalogues cite, one entry per document. A record's `source_refs` name the record inside its document — `manual`, `printed_page` and `section` — and its `url` resolves here, which is what lets a cotejo go from a catalogue record to the document that prints it without knowing anything about the tree it runs in. `mirror` is where the offline mirror (`build/cache/`) keeps the downloaded copy; a document without a copy there is a declared gap the cotejo reports, not a registry error.

manual.description: Registered source id the document belongs to; it is the `manual` value the citing records use.

kind.description: How the document is read: `pdf` for the geometry corpus, `page` for the web-page corpus (its HTML snapshot, or the plain-text twin as fallback).

mirror.description: Path of the downloaded copy relative to the mirror root, e.g. `2b-pdfs/adventurers-kaz.pdf`.

urls.description: Every location the same document is cited by; the catalogues cite the same PDF with more than one spelling, and one document coteja one copy.
